name: warden-training-cooldown|Warden Training cuts Warden's Blade cooldown by 25% (#731)
contract: Warden Training 704790 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive 0x1c0) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11), EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x04000000 and EffectBasePoints -26 which resolves to -25 with DieSides 1, matching 'Reduces the cooldown of Warden's Blade by $s1%'. Warden's Blade rank 1 805508 and rank 6 806816 carry SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x04000000 and RecoveryTime 20000 (CategoryRecoveryTime 20000). Native path only: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN through Player::ApplySpellMod and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod admits the modifier on the shared family and mask; neither spell carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (0x20000000). The spell_modifier metric runs that same ApplySpellMod on the shipped RecoveryTime: 20000 x 0.75 = 15000. Astral Blade 805563 (word2 0x200000, RecoveryTime 20000) has a different class mask and must stay at 20000, so the modifier is not a blanket cooldown cut. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Warden's Blade rank 1 cooldown is unmodified without the talent
Warden's Blade rank 1 cooldown drops to 15 sec with the talent
